SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) PRIOR RESULTS: iter-1 ep8 -> SSIM 0.4413 / hr 0.000 / PSNR 20.44 / RMSE 0.004756, elapsed 191.1s; iter-2 ep48 -> SSIM 0.5927 / hr 0.000 / PSNR 24.77 / RMSE 0.002886, elapsed 387.4s. The pretrain_epochs lever moves SSIM (0.4413->0.5927, +0.151 over 8->48 ep) but hr stays PINNED at 0.000 -- v1 is still BELOW the ~0.81 LD-FBP floor after a 6x pretrain increase. CONTRAST: the lever-twin itnet_v2 (same pretrain-then-DC family) climbed ep48 0.5888 -> ep144 0.6230 (3x epochs for only +0.034 SSIM, hr still 0.000 -- severe diminishing returns), while the END-TO-END-trained sibling itnet_v3 sits at 0.905 / hr 0.312 at iter-3. v1 (0.44->0.59) and v2 (0.59->0.62) trace the SAME under-0.81 curve; v3 (0.91) is on a different curve entirely. (3) ONE KNOB: pretrain_epochs 48 -> 160 (3.3x), mirroring v2's 48->144 ceiling-probe escalation. (4) HYPOTHESIS + FALSIFIER: a final hard push of the only trainable component. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. rationale: tv_iterative_supervised-claude-agentic: val_n=214, val_chunk=5, train_n=40, epochs=8, batch_size=1, lr=0.05, tv_K=30, tv_step_init=1e-08, tv_lambda_init=0.001, tv_share_steps=False, tv_clip_max=0.05, tv_eps=1e-06, lambda_neg=1.0, loss_base=mse, grad_clip=1.0, rationale=tv_iterative_supervised iter-3 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). TRAINING-DIAGNOSIS iter, NOT a hyperparameter tune. PRIOR: iter-1 (K=10) SSIM 0.285541 hr 0.0 PSNR 1.87 elapsed 321.5s; iter-2 (K=30) SSIM 0.285541 hr 0.0 PSNR 1.87 elapsed 946s -- BYTE-IDENTICAL to every digit, comparison.png identical (289606 B). iter-2 deepened the unroll 10->30 and the result did NOT change AT ALL -> depth is FALSIFIED as the limiter. SLURM TRAINING LOG (jobs 765204 iter-1 / 765283 iter-2) shows the smoking gun: loss=0.001739 IDENTICAL across all 8 epochs, and the learnable step[k]=0.01, lambda[k]=0.001 PINNED at init for all 8 epochs -- the 20/60 scalars receive ZERO gradient and never move. FAILURE MODE (named): the supervised TV TRAINING is structurally frozen by a SATURATED-CLAMP gradient kill. Mechanism: data_grad = back_project(Rf - sino) is the RAW unfiltered adjoint of a 2304-view Mayo sinogram (sum-scaled, NO 1/N normalization). The classical tv_iterative sibling (SSIM 0.92) computes its gradient via AUTOGRAD on 0.5*mean(residual^2) -- a mean over 2304*736~1.7e6 elements -> per-element gradient ~1.7e6x SMALLER. tv_step_init=0.01 was inherited from the classical sibling's tv_lr but the supervised path's gradient is ~1.7e6x bigger, so f - 0.01*data_grad overshoots massively -> clamp(0,0.05) saturates the WHOLE image at K=1 -> the saturated clamp has derivative 0 everywhere -> no gradient reaches log_step/log_lambda -> scalars frozen, recon a near-constant clamped blob (PSNR 1.87, RMSE 0.0403) regardless of K. baseline LD-FBP PSNR=34.08 (Wagner-grade) confirms the data/projector are fine -- only the unrolled step scale is wrong. ONE CHANGE (un-stick training): tv_step_init 0.01 -> 1e-8 (operator-norm-matched: 0.01 / (2304*736) ~ 6e-9, rounded to 1e-8) so the unrolled iteration stays INSIDE the [0,0.05] clamp basin where the clamp is NOT saturated and gradients flow to the scalars. PAIRED ENABLER (not an independent knob -- with frozen gradients lr is inert): outer lr 5e-3 -> 5e-2 so the now-NONZERO scalar gradients move meaningfully across 8 epochs over the log-parametrised step/lambda. The (B,F,H,W)=(4,16,512,512) x 31-bump RBF activation tensors held across 5 unrolled steps for autograd blew the card. NOTE: this hammernik_2017 solver is a PURE IMAGE-DOMAIN denoiser of the FBP (no projector in the unrolled loop) and does NOT read vn_checkpoint or vn_dc_norm (verified by grep over every cfg[...]/cfg.get(...) in the solver: only vn_T/vn_n_filters/vn_kernel/vn_n_bumps/vn_x_range/vn_*_init_std/vn_lambda_init/epochs/batch_size/lr/grad_clip/train_n/val_n/seed/max_train_s are consumed). Those two knobs belong to the SIBLING projector-in-loop hammernik_vn solver; passing them here would be silently ignored, so they are intentionally omitted -- the operative fix this solver honors is the batch halving (+ grad_clip=1.0 already present for VN-family NaN-skip stability). Budget: HARD 20-min train+score; val=ALL 214 L277 slices (321px detector-geometry FOV default, no fov= override; staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps, bg_target=truth). batch=2 ~doubles steps/epoch, so epochs 40->14 (mirrors the sibling hammernik_vn iter-1 that scored 0.805 in 1296s); max_train_s=1000 (16.7min in-solver wall) is the binding constraint and leaves ~3min for score(214)+figure under the 30min SLURM kill. capacity kept modest (vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16). rationale: hammernik_vn-claude-agentic: vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=1.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_init=fbp, vn_dc_norm=True, vn_checkpoint=True, vn_normalize_filters=False, epochs=14, batch_size=2, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=214, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=FRESH search-20260619-01 iter-1 FEASIBILITY (corrected protocol: val=ALL 214 L277 slices + 321px detector-geometry FOV; HARD 20-min train+score budget; staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps FBP init + per-step model.projector swap, bg_target=truth, no fov= override). Hammernik-VN = MRI variational net ported to CT: T untied unrolled steps, each = learned filter-bank + per-filter RBF activation (the _rho_prime bump loop) PLUS an in-loop PYRO-NN projector data-consistency step (architectural twin of LPD/ItNet but tiny interpretable regulariser). CRITICAL LESSON from the SIBLING hammernik_2017 iter-1: it did NOT diverge to 0.0 -- it CUDA-OOM'd in _rho_prime at 72s with batch_size=4 (16GB RTX5000; the (B,F,H,W)=(4,16,512,512) x 31-bump RBF tensors + 5-step autograd blew the card). So the dominant iter-1 risk here is MEMORY, not divergence. MITIGATION: batch_size=2 (NOT 4), vn_n_filters=16 (below the 24 default -> fewer RBF tensors), vn_checkpoint=true (gradient-checkpoints each unrolled step -- hammernik_vn HAS this knob, cuts activation memory ~T-fold; this is the key difference that lets the projector-in-loop VN fit where the 2017 batch=4 did not). STABILITY against the documented VN family divergence/NaN->0.0 trap: grad_clip=1.0 (MANDATORY -- the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint overflows the backward; clip_and_step also SKIPS nonfinite-gradient batches so a poisoned step can't collapse the recon to a constant), vn_dc_norm=true (power-iter normalizes R^T(Rx-g) so softplus(lambda_t) stays O(1) regardless of geometry -- the safeguard the projector-less 2017 lacked), lr=5e-4 (the documented hammernik_vn optimum from the discarded run; 8e-4 was worse, brief caps lr<=5e-4), vn_lambda_init=2.3e-3 (loose VN-port working-corner hint). CAPACITY conservative per brief: vn_T=5, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=1.0 (FBP recon is ~O(1) so the RBF grid [-1,1] covers it). BUDGET: reference -- LPD (projector-in-loop, T=7, ep30, train200, score214) ran 1150s/19.2min right at the edge; hammernik_vn at T=5/N_k=16/checkpointed should be comparable-or-cheaper per step. max_train_s=1000 (16.7min in-solver wall) is the BINDING constraint (epochs=14 is just an upper bound the wall trips first), leaving ~3min for score(214)+figure under the 30min SLURM kill. HYPOTHESIS: if I run a budget-sized, MEMORY-SAFE (batch=2, checkpointed), STABLE (grad_clip=1.0, dc_norm) Hammernik-VN, I expect (a) it AVOIDS the hammernik_2017 OOM and produces a FINITE val_ssim within 20min, and (b) the projector DC step lands it near or above the ~0.84 LD-FBP SSIM floor -- because a learned-regulariser + true-projector-DC unroll is a sound Mayo recon family (sibling LPD/ItNet/DD-sup all run finite here). This onboarding iter establishes the corrected-metric VN baseline that iter-2+ tunes one knob at a time (epochs/wall first to confirm convergence, then vn_T or vn_lambda_init).
